status: Reusable starting presets; new assets require inspection and qualification

identity.source_guidance: Consistent person, neutral illumination, sharp unobscured face; frontal and complementary three-quarter/profile views. Keep voice in a separate asset.

location.source_guidance: Empty location with consistent layout and light across angles. Record doors, windows, landmarks, seating and camera positions. Select one primary picture separately per shot.

voice.source_guidance: Clean speech by the authorized speaker without music or competing voices; connect audio VAE and an audio-only source.

notes: A visual location uses concept_type background. Ambience is an audio concept in Fantastic Draft from RefMods; this preset correction does not rewrite existing RefMod files.
Full Reference is encode mode: grid and refinement_steps are not evidence that optimization occurred. Do not silently switch to Compressed Reference.
The stored source, encoder frames and token count must be inspected after creation; filename and preview alone do not establish quality.
7250 is a per-asset save ceiling from the current test settings, not a combined-run VRAM guarantee. It is an editable setting, not a source-count rule.
Wardrobe and props remain separate full-detail picture assets; derive their names, owner and instructions from the asset registry.
These presets do not create, replace or approve any asset automatically.
